name: Coringasuchus
isnote: Described as perhaps a notosuchian within Mesoeucrocodylia (English Wikipedia).
sum: Coringasuchus is a mesoeucrocodylian crocodyliform, perhaps a notosuchian, from the Cenomanian Alcântara Formation of Brazil.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Cranial material from the Alcântara Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Kellner et al. 2009
